text: dsh-activity-heatmap 是面向 DSH Web 界面的本地使用活动日历插件。Host 端读取本机的会话持久化、会话查询或当前会话服务，将消息、工具调用、轮次、Token、活跃分钟和会话数按本地日期汇总，再由浏览器端绘制热图。它提供设置页完整日历、侧栏热图入口和可选输入框条带，并支持选择统计指标、日历布局、形状、配色和强度。适合想回顾 DSH 使用节奏的用户；需要 DSH 提供 webServer 与 Web UI，不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-activity-heatmap shows local DSH activity in a Web UI heatmap. It counts daily messages, tool calls, turns, tokens, active minutes, and sessions. Choose metrics, layouts, shapes, and colors in settings; open it from the sidebar. Requires DSH Web UI and webServer, no API key.
想看自己每天用了多少 DSH，会话活跃情况能画成日历吗？
给 DSH 加一个类似 GitHub contributions 的使用热图。
Can I see a calendar heatmap of my daily DSH activity?
dsh-activity-heatmap 的功能「每日会话统计」：按本地日期汇总会话数、轮次、消息、工具调用、Token 和活跃分钟。打开 Web 界面后由 Host 扫描本地会话记录，并向浏览器提供统计数据。
dsh-activity-heatmap 的功能「可配置活动日历」：在 Activity 设置页查看完整热图，并可从侧栏或输入框条带访问。用户可以选择指标、年度或滚动布局、单元形状和配色等外观选项。

dsh-activity-heatmap README · dsh-activity-heatmap：English | [日本語](README.ja.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

A GitHub-style activity heatmap for DeepSeek Harness.

It counts how much you actually use the app — messages, tool calls, turns, tokens, active minutes, and sessions — straight from your own local session logs, then draws one cell per day. Square, rounded, round, hexagon, diamond, star, and your own SVG path. Five palettes plus per-level colors. Year, twelve-month, and rolling calendar layouts. Everything is configurable in the app.

dsh-activity-heatmap README · dsh-activity-heatmap：No outbound network requests. No session content leaves your machine. The plugin's Host half only returns counts.

dsh-activity-heatmap README · Ask the agent (easiest)：The agent installs the bundle with the `plugin_manager` tool. Agent instructions live in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md); the human-readable version is in [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md).

dsh-activity-heatmap README · From the Plugins page：1. Open **Plugins** in the sidebar.
2. Choose **Add plugin** (or the arrow → **Install a third-party plugin**).
3. Paste `https://github.com/4uthen7/dsh-activity-heatmap` and confirm.
4. Enable the bundle if it is installed switched off.

dsh-activity-heatmap README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness with the Web UI (Desktop or the `web` profile).
- Any DSH version that ships the `sessionPersistence`, `sessionQuery`, and `webServer` services. The plugin degrades gracefully: if persistence is absent it counts Session creation days only.

dsh-activity-heatmap README · Where it appears：Pick any combination in **Settings → Activity → Appearance**.

- **Sidebar widget** — a strip in the sidebar footer row above Settings. Click it to open the full heatmap. Choose 7–52 weeks.
- **Sidebar panel** — an **Activity** row in the navigation list above Workspaces. It opens the full heatmap in the main area.
- **Composer strip** — an optional compact strip below the composer. Off by default.
- **Settings → Activity** — the complete page with every option.

dsh-activity-heatmap README · Where it appears：The Workspaces header belongs to the shipped session browser, and DSH exposes no additive full-width seat directly above it; replacing that slot would remove the session list. The plugin uses the additive footer seat for the strip and the panel row for one-click access. [Sidebar detail](docs/demo-sidebar.png) · [Full page](docs/demo-main.png).

The page is named by the active UI language: `Activity`, `アクティビティ`, or `活动`.

dsh-activity-heatmap README · What is counted：One cell per local day, in the browser's IANA time zone:

| Measure | Source |
| --- | --- |
| Messages | `user/message` and `assistant/message` events |
| Tool calls | `tool/call` events |
| Turns | `turn/start` events |
| Tokens | input + output tokens reported on assistant messages |
| Active time | distinct minutes in which any session event was recorded |
| Sessions | sessions created that day (by header `createdAt`) |

dsh-activity-heatmap README · What is counted：A session log is read once per revision and cached in Host memory; unchanged sessions are skipped on later refreshes. Forked or seeded sessions contain inherited history, so their earlier days can be counted again. Counts are approximate by design — this is a usage glance, not billing.
dsh-activity-heatmap README · Options：All options are per browser (`localStorage`, key `dsh-activity-heatmap/settings/v1`) and apply immediately.

dsh-activity-heatmap README · Options：| Option | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Measure | Messages, Active time, Tool calls, Turns, Sessions, Tokens | Messages |
| Calendar | Year (53 weeks), Months (12 mini calendars), Rolling (13/26/52 weeks) | Year |
| Shape | Square, Rounded, Circle, Hexagon, Diamond, Star, Custom SVG path | Square |
| Cell size | 5–20 px | 8 px |
| Spacing | 1–8 px | 2 px |
| Palette | GitHub, Ocean, Violet, Sunset, Mono, Custom | GitHub |
| Colors | 4 intensity colors + theme-colored empty days | GitHub greens |
| Week starts on | Sunday, Monday | Monday |
| Intensity | Linear, Log, Rank (quantile) | Linear |
| Labels | Month labels, weekday labels, legend | On |
| Sidebar widget | Show/hide, 7–52 weeks | On, 22 weeks |
| Composer strip | Show/hide | Off |
dsh-activity-heatmap README · Options：A custom shape is an SVG path written for a `0 0 100 100` view box, for example `M50 4 L96 92 L4 92 Z`. Invalid path data is ignored and the square is used.

dsh-activity-heatmap README · Privacy：- The Host half registers one exact loopback route, `/plugin-api/activity-heatmap/stats`, and it answers with counts only: date, sessions, turns, messages, tool calls, tokens, events, active minutes.
- No prompt, response, file path, title, or tool argument is returned.
- The plugin makes no outbound network request.
- Counts are computed from the local Session corpus through the read-only `sessionPersistence` / `sessionQuery` services.

dsh-activity-heatmap README · Compatibility and removal：The bundle inserts one Host row (`activity-heatmap`) and one Client module. It declares `webServer` as its only hard Host dependency; without it the plugin stays inactive.

Remove it from **Plugins** → the bundle's page → **Remove**. Browser settings remain until you clear site data.

dsh-activity-heatmap README · Development：No build step: the package ships plain ESM for the Host and a plain-JavaScript Client module.

```
index.js            Host half: Session scan, per-day counters, stats route
client.js           Browser half: stores, heatmap, sidebar widget, panel, settings page
cordis.patch.yml    Bundle row
locale/{en,ja,zh}.json   Plugin Manager title/description

Install a working checkout:

```text
plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "/absolute/path/to/dsh-activity-heatmap" }
```
dsh-activity-heatmap README · Development：After editing `client.js`, reload the page. After editing `index.js`, toggle the row off and on (or restart) so the Host module is imported again.
